briefing.headline: US-China AI compute gap narrows as xAI and DeepSeek release frontier models

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensifies with multiple frontier model releases this month. Compute constraints and safety concerns dominate strategic discussions amid record funding.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4-preview with advanced reasoning capabilities. Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus while Meta open-sources Llama 4. xAI and DeepSeek push multimodal boundaries in competitive launches.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New EU AI Act enforcement begins targeting agentic systems.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp accelerates despite shortages. Google and Microsoft announce major data center expansions in Texas and Arizona totaling 50GW capacity.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory fragmentation slow AGI progress more than compute bottlenecks by 2028?
